+| 1749 | 3100089 / AMR-030-0089 | Let G be a bicolored graph, and let H be the graph whose vertices are the valid pressing sequences of G and whose edges | 0.0585 | 5.0 | 3 | unknown | unsolved | ≥1; total unknown |  | 2026-10-11: Six-vertex graph has exactly two successful words at insertion/deletion distance 8, refuting only total-four and total-six versions; it does not refute original Bixby-Flint-Miklos four-deletion/four-insertion connectivity, and four substitutions suffice. Legal-prefix connectivity is trivial; intended edit convention remains a boundary. [Normalization proof and audit, draft PR #1313](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/1313). For matrices admitting a successful word, additional positive partials prove original-threshold connectivity for rank<=5 at arbitrary vertex count and, in every rank, when a successful word exists and every norm-one radical-quotient vector has an original-coordinate representative. General connectivity remains unresolved. 2026-10-12: Further AI-reviewed, unrefereed partial results: every successful word in any nonunique pressable rank-r binary symmetric matrix has a distinct word with LCS at least r−4, sharply; hence original-threshold connectivity for at most three words, nonsingular rank at most six, and rank-six configurations whose distinct nonzero quotient images form a basis with duplicates/zeros. A black coordinate is universally terminal exactly when its column equals the diagonal; the constructive converse yields necessary separation signatures and a four-edge bridge when the signature fails in the auxiliary LCS-at-least-two graph. That auxiliary threshold equals the original threshold at rank six only. Named external inputs are Cooper–Whitlatch unique pressability and Bixby–Flint–Miklós pressability existence. General original four-deletion/four-insertion connectivity remains open; no novelty claim. [Complete proofs and audits](attempts/3100089_short_neighbor_terminal_appendix/README.md). 2026-10-12: A further AI-reviewed, unrefereed appendix establishes original-threshold connectivity for every successfully pressable rank-six binary symmetric matrix with arbitrary ambient labels, with diameter at most six. Its full symbolic lifting reduction uses the accepted terminal/signature bridge and a completely checked positive finite lemma covering 98,304 root/vector pairs and 98,306 edges; raw witnesses and programs are not distributed in the prose edition. Together with the prior lower-rank result this covers ranks at most six. Separately, an explicit rank-eight four-word example has exactly two components under all unique-overlap interval substitutions but a connected original-threshold four-cycle, obstructing iteration of that restricted move strategy without refuting BFM. Full hand-checkable branch proofs and complete audits are included. General original four-deletion/four-insertion connectivity in ranks seven and higher and all-four-word classification remain open; no novelty claim. [Complete proofs and audits](attempts/3100089_rank_six_overlap_appendix/README.md). 2026-10-12: A further AI-reviewed, unrefereed symbolic reduction narrows a hypothetical disconnected four-word pressing instance. After zero-coordinate deletion, with e equal to nonzero-coordinate count minus rank, Z is at least 2 max(2,e+1) for a disconnected nonunique language, so four words force e at most one. In corank one, disconnection requires two disjoint omission edges, four uniquely pressable full-rank endpoint restrictions, and a one-column union of genuinely distinct alternate unique roots. These conditions are necessary only; omission-graph disconnection need not imply original-graph disconnection, one-column trajectory rigidity is unproved, and the nonsingular four-word case remains unresolved. The accepted arbitrary-ambient rank-at-most-six theorem already excludes both residual forms through rank six. Bounded checks through order five corroborate the symbolic reduction without proving rigidity or classification. General original four-deletion/four-insertion connectivity remains open for rank seven and above; no novelty claim. Complete proof and audit: unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/3100089_four_word_reduction_appendix/README.md. |  |
